main_text.l: Proinde explicare debent suorum instru-
mentorum & fabricam sive naturam & usum.

l.i: Instrumenti vis tota consistit in actione, ait Logi-
cus. Non igitur satis est, in artibus instrumento-
insuper eorundem usum adjicere. Ita Rhetorica non
tantum instrumenta sua, tropos & figuras, explica-
bit ratione architecturæ, sed etiam applicare docebit

main_text.l: PERORATIO
TECHNOLOGIÆ.
CNncludam[?] nunc Technologiam meam, indica-
tione usus, qui inde ad studiosos redire potest, pre-
cum item & typi adjectione.
Utilitas è technologia ad vos redibit, ô studiosi,
permagna. Etenim discetis differentias & proprie-
tates disciplinarum: videbitis, quâ methodo pro-
poni & disci debeant: videbitis, quot sint numero
disciplinæ, & quænam ex iis vobis discenda sint: co-
gnoscetis demq; ad quam quidq; disciplinam refer-
re possitis, & quomodo unam eandemq; rem per varias
disciplinas deducere liceat, id quod philosophi vo-
cant sigillum technologiæ, sive encyclopædiæ.
v.g.dicturus de pane, eum considerabit Metaphysicè,
Physicè, OEconomicè, aliúsq; modis. Preces adjicito
mecum, quicunque cupis hanc technologiam, vel
quasdam saltem ejus partes percurrere: Domine
Deus, pater cœlestis, ago tibi gratias, cùm pro aliis
tuis summis & infinitis beneficiis, tùm vel maxi-
mè, quòd gratissimam de tuâ sapientiâ, bonitate,
& potentiâ famam in artibus sparsisti. Rogo te,
clementissime Pater, doce me, quæ nescio, pra-[?]

page.notes: The drop cap "CNncludam" is doubtful: the initial may be "Co" with a larger initial, so the word is marked [?]. The last word "pra-" is cut at the line end and the hyphen is kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout ("fuorum" is "suorum", "poteft" is "potest", "figillum" is "sigillum"). The marginal numbers 1.–4. are read from their position beside the lines.
